name: CSS Competitive Examination (Central Superior Services)
name_ur: سی ایس ایس مقابلے کا امتحان (سنٹرل سپیریئر سروسز)
provider: Federal Public Service Commission (FPSC), Government of Pakistan
target_group: Graduates from any discipline seeking entry to the federal civil service in BPS-17
summary_en: The annual written competition that recruits officers into the federal civil service at BPS-17. Open to graduates of any discipline from anywhere in Pakistan, with seats allotted under the regional quota. The written papers include compulsory English essay and precis, so a strong command of written English matters more here than in most government entries.
summary_ur: یہ سالانہ تحریری مقابلہ ہے جس کے ذریعے وفاقی سول سروس میں گریڈ 17 کے افسر بھرتی کیے جاتے ہیں۔ پاکستان بھر سے کسی بھی مضمون کے گریجویٹ درخواست دے سکتے ہیں اور نشستیں علاقائی کوٹے کے تحت مختص ہوتی ہیں۔ لازمی انگریزی مضمون اور تلخیص کے پرچے شامل ہیں، اس لیے تحریری انگریزی پر عبور یہاں خاص اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: Seats are allocated under the regional/provincial quota formula, with reserved shares for women and for religious minorities. Age relaxation of two years is available to candidates from specified regions and categories - check the current year's rules before assuming the upper limit rules you out. The degree must be at least second division (roughly 45%).

required_documents: Bachelor's degree and full transcript (second division or above)
Application fee challan (deposited in a designated branch)
application_steps: Check the CSS advertisement for the current year on fpsc.gov.pk
Create an account on the FPSC online application system
Fill the online form and choose your optional subject groups within the allowed marks combination
Deposit the examination fee and upload the paid challan
Submit before the closing date and print the acknowledgement
Post the hard copy of the form with attested documents if the advertisement requires it
source_title: FPSC - CSS Competitive Examination rules and advertisement page
disclaimer: The CSS eligibility rules are stable year to year, but the optional-subject combinations and the examination schedule are set fresh each cycle. Eligibility details were confirmed against the official source on 2026-09-12. The application deadline shown is a provisional placeholder for the expected cycle, not a date the authority has announced - confirm it on the official page before applying.

name: FPSC Consolidated Advertisement - Federal BPS-17 posts
name_ur: ایف پی ایس سی مشترکہ اشتہار - وفاقی گریڈ 17 کی آسامیاں
provider: Federal Public Service Commission (FPSC), Government of Pakistan
target_group: Graduates with a couple of years of relevant experience applying for federal officer-grade posts
summary_en: FPSC advertises federal ministry and department posts in batches through numbered consolidated advertisements several times a year. This entry covers the officer-grade (BPS-17) posts in those batches that ask for a degree plus around two years of relevant experience. Each individual post has its own subject and experience requirement, so read the post you are applying for.
summary_ur: ایف پی ایس سی سال میں کئی بار نمبر شدہ مشترکہ اشتہارات کے ذریعے وفاقی وزارتوں اور محکموں کی آسامیاں مشتہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ اندراج ان بیچوں میں شامل گریڈ 17 کی افسر سطح کی آسامیوں کے بارے میں ہے جن کے لیے ڈگری کے ساتھ تقریباً دو سال کا متعلقہ تجربہ درکار ہوتا ہے۔ ہر آسامی کی اپنی مضمون اور تجربے کی شرط ہوتی ہے، اس لیے متعلقہ آسامی کی تفصیل ضرور پڑھیں۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: Posts are filled against the regional/provincial quota, with reserved shares for women, religious minorities and persons with disabilities. General age relaxation of five years applies to several categories, so an age slightly over the limit is often still workable - check the advertisement. Experience requirements differ post by post; some posts in the same advertisement ask for none at all.

required_documents: All educational certificates, degrees and transcripts
Departmental permission / NOC if you are already a government employee
application_steps: Open the current consolidated advertisement on fpsc.gov.pk and find the case number of the post you want
Confirm you meet that specific post's qualification and experience requirement
Apply online through the FPSC portal against that case number
Deposit the fee and upload the paid challan
Submit before the closing date and keep the acknowledgement
Send the hard copy with attested documents if the advertisement asks for it
disclaimer: This covers a recurring recruitment stream rather than one named vacancy. Post titles, seat counts and the exact experience requirement change with every consolidated advertisement. Eligibility details were confirmed against the official source on 2026-09-12. The application deadline shown is a provisional placeholder for the expected cycle, not a date the authority has announced - confirm it on the official page before applying.

name: PPSC Assistant (BS-16) - Punjab government departments
name_ur: پی پی ایس سی اسسٹنٹ (گریڈ 16) - محکمہ جات حکومت پنجاب
provider: Punjab Public Service Commission (PPSC), Government of Punjab
target_group: Punjab-domicile graduates applying for clerical-officer posts in provincial departments
summary_en: PPSC recruits Assistants in BS-16 for Punjab government departments through a written test followed by an interview. A bachelor's degree and Punjab domicile are the core requirements, and the test includes a computer and general knowledge component. This is one of the most common entry points into the Punjab provincial service for fresh graduates.
summary_ur: پی پی ایس سی حکومت پنجاب کے محکموں کے لیے گریڈ 16 کے اسسٹنٹ تحریری امتحان اور انٹرویو کے ذریعے بھرتی کرتا ہے۔ بنیادی شرائط بیچلر ڈگری اور پنجاب ڈومیسائل ہیں، اور امتحان میں کمپیوٹر اور جنرل نالج کا حصہ بھی شامل ہوتا ہے۔ نئے گریجویٹس کے لیے یہ پنجاب کی صوبائی سروس میں داخلے کا سب سے عام راستہ ہے۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: Punjab operates reserved quotas for women, minorities, persons with disabilities and children of serving or retired government employees in certain cadres. General age relaxation of five years applies to several categories, so check the advertisement rather than assuming the upper limit excludes you.

required_documents: Matric, Intermediate and Bachelor's certificates with transcripts
Disability certificate or other category certificate, if claiming a reserved seat
application_steps: Find the current Assistant (BS-16) advertisement on ppsc.gop.pk
Register or log in to the PPSC online application system
Complete the online form and upload the required documents
Deposit the fee at a designated bank and enter the challan details
Submit before the closing date and download the confirmation
Watch the PPSC site for the written test roll number slip
disclaimer: The age limit and required qualification differ slightly between Punjab departments advertising the same Assistant post. Eligibility details were confirmed against the official source on 2026-09-12. The application deadline shown is a provisional placeholder for the expected cycle, not a date the authority has announced - confirm it on the official page before applying.

name: SPSC Combined Competitive Examination - Sindh provincial service
name_ur: ایس پی ایس سی مشترکہ مقابلے کا امتحان - سندھ صوبائی سروس
provider: Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC), Government of Sindh
target_group: Sindh-domicile graduates seeking officer-grade entry into the provincial civil service
summary_en: Sindh's provincial equivalent of the CSS examination, recruiting officers into the Sindh civil service in BPS-17 through written papers and an interview. Open to graduates of any discipline who hold a Sindh domicile, with seats distributed between urban and rural quotas.
summary_ur: یہ سی ایس ایس کے مساوی سندھ کا صوبائی امتحان ہے، جس کے ذریعے تحریری پرچوں اور انٹرویو کے بعد سندھ سول سروس میں گریڈ 17 کے افسر بھرتی کیے جاتے ہیں۔ سندھ ڈومیسائل رکھنے والے کسی بھی مضمون کے گریجویٹ درخواست دے سکتے ہیں، اور نشستیں شہری اور دیہی کوٹے کے تحت تقسیم ہوتی ہیں۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: Seats are split between the urban and rural areas of Sindh under the provincial quota, with reserved shares for women, minorities and persons with disabilities. Age relaxation applies to several categories; check the current advertisement. The degree must be at least second division.

required_documents: Sindh domicile certificate and PRC (Permanent Residence Certificate)
Matric, Intermediate and Bachelor's certificates with transcripts
application_steps: Open the Combined Competitive Examination advertisement on spsc.gov.pk
Register on the SPSC online application portal
Fill the form and select your optional subjects within the permitted combination
Deposit the fee and record the challan details on the form
Submit before the closing date and retain the printed application
Track the SPSC site for the written examination schedule
disclaimer: Urban and rural quota shares are set per cycle and decide how the seats are distributed. Eligibility details were confirmed against the official source on 2026-09-12. The application deadline shown is a provisional placeholder for the expected cycle, not a date the authority has announced - confirm it on the official page before applying.

name: KPPSC Lecturer (BPS-17) - Higher Education Department, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
name_ur: کے پی پی ایس سی لیکچرار (گریڈ 17) - محکمہ اعلیٰ تعلیم خیبر پختونخوا
target_group: KP-domicile candidates with a master's degree who want to teach in government colleges
summary_en: KPPSC recruits Lecturers in BPS-17 for government colleges across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, subject by subject, through a written test and interview. A master's degree in the relevant subject and a KP domicile are required. Posts are advertised separately for male and female colleges, which is why women's seats are a substantial share of each drive.
summary_ur: کے پی پی ایس سی خیبر پختونخوا کے سرکاری کالجوں کے لیے گریڈ 17 کے لیکچرار تحریری امتحان اور انٹرویو کے ذریعے مضمون وار بھرتی کرتا ہے۔ متعلقہ مضمون میں ماسٹرز ڈگری اور کے پی ڈومیسائل لازمی ہیں۔ آسامیاں مردانہ اور زنانہ کالجوں کے لیے الگ الگ مشتہر ہوتی ہیں، اس لیے ہر بھرتی میں خواتین کی نشستیں خاصی تعداد میں ہوتی ہیں۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: Lecturer posts are advertised subject by subject, and your master's degree must be in the subject you are applying to teach - a master's in a different discipline will not be accepted for that post. Separate seats are advertised for women's colleges. Age relaxation applies to several categories under KP rules.

required_documents: Matric, Intermediate, Bachelor's and Master's certificates with transcripts
HEC equivalence certificate if the degree is from a foreign institution
application_steps: Check the current Lecturer advertisement on kppsc.gov.pk and find your subject
Confirm your master's degree is in that exact subject
Apply online through the KPPSC portal against the correct post number
Deposit the fee and enter the challan details
Submit before the closing date and save the acknowledgement
Download the roll number slip when the written test is scheduled
disclaimer: Lecturer posts are advertised subject by subject; which subjects are open, and how many seats each carries, changes with every advertisement. Eligibility details were confirmed against the official source on 2026-09-12. The application deadline shown is a provisional placeholder for the expected cycle, not a date the authority has announced - confirm it on the official page before applying.

name: BPSC Combined Competitive Examination - Balochistan provincial service
name_ur: بی پی ایس سی مشترکہ مقابلے کا امتحان - بلوچستان صوبائی سروس
target_group: Balochistan-domicile graduates seeking officer-grade entry into the provincial civil service
summary_en: Balochistan's provincial competitive examination, recruiting officers into the provincial civil service in BPS-17 through written papers and an interview. Open to graduates of any discipline holding a Balochistan domicile, with seats distributed across district quotas so candidates from less-served districts compete within their own district rather than against the whole province.
summary_ur: یہ بلوچستان کا صوبائی مقابلے کا امتحان ہے، جس کے ذریعے تحریری پرچوں اور انٹرویو کے بعد صوبائی سول سروس میں گریڈ 17 کے افسر بھرتی کیے جاتے ہیں۔ بلوچستان ڈومیسائل رکھنے والے کسی بھی مضمون کے گریجویٹ درخواست دے سکتے ہیں، اور نشستیں ضلعی کوٹے کے تحت تقسیم ہوتی ہیں تاکہ پسماندہ اضلاع کے امیدوار اپنے ضلعے کے اندر مقابلہ کریں۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: Seats are allocated by district quota, which is a real advantage for candidates from less-served districts of Balochistan. Reserved shares also exist for women, minorities and persons with disabilities, and age relaxation applies to several categories. The degree must be at least second division.

required_documents: Local certificate / district certificate for the quota claim
Matric, Intermediate and Bachelor's certificates with transcripts
application_steps: Open the Combined Competitive Examination advertisement on bpsc.gob.pk
Register on the BPSC online application system
Fill the form, select your optional subjects and declare your district for the quota
Deposit the fee and enter the challan details
Submit before the closing date and print the application
Watch the BPSC site for the examination schedule and roll number slip
disclaimer: Seats are allocated by district quota, so the competition you face depends on the district on your domicile. Eligibility details were confirmed against the official source on 2026-09-12. The application deadline shown is a provisional placeholder for the expected cycle, not a date the authority has announced - confirm it on the official page before applying.

name: Punjab Police - Constable recruitment
target_group: Punjab-domicile matriculates, women and men, willing to meet the physical standards
summary_en: Punjab Police runs district-wise constable recruitment drives that need matriculation rather than a degree, which makes this one of the few government entries open to candidates who did not continue past Matric. Selection is a physical test followed by a written test and medical examination. Recruitment for women constables is advertised alongside the general drive.
summary_ur: پنجاب پولیس ضلع وار کانسٹیبل بھرتی کرتی ہے جس کے لیے ڈگری نہیں بلکہ میٹرک درکار ہے، اس لیے یہ ان چند سرکاری مواقع میں سے ایک ہے جو میٹرک کے بعد تعلیم جاری نہ رکھنے والوں کے لیے کھلے ہیں۔ انتخاب کا مرحلہ جسمانی ٹیسٹ، پھر تحریری ٹیسٹ اور میڈیکل معائنہ ہے۔ خواتین کانسٹیبلز کی بھرتی بھی عام بھرتی کے ساتھ مشتہر کی جاتی ہے۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: There are height, chest and running standards that this screening cannot check for you - read them in the advertisement before you apply, because they decide the first stage. Separate seats are advertised for women constables, and the physical standards for women differ from those for men. Recruitment is district-wise, so your district of domicile determines where you apply.

required_documents: Medical fitness certificate at the relevant stage
application_steps: Check punjabpolice.gov.pk or the district police office for the current constable recruitment advertisement
Confirm the height and physical standards that apply to you before spending on documents
Submit the application form at the designated recruitment centre for your district
Appear for the physical measurement and running test
Appear for the written test if you clear the physical stage
Complete the medical examination and character verification
disclaimer: Constable recruitment runs district by district and is not open in every district at the same time. Height and physical standards are decisive and are not screened here - read them in the advertisement first. Eligibility details were confirmed against the official source on 2026-09-12. The application deadline shown is a provisional placeholder for the expected cycle, not a date the authority has announced - confirm it on the official page before applying.

name: Pakistan Post - Postal Assistant and support staff recruitment
name_ur: پاکستان پوسٹ - پوسٹل اسسٹنٹ اور معاون عملے کی بھرتی
provider: Pakistan Post Office Department, Ministry of Communications
target_group: Intermediate-qualified candidates anywhere in Pakistan looking for a permanent federal clerical post
summary_en: Pakistan Post recruits Postal Assistants and other clerical staff across its circles nationwide, needing Intermediate rather than a degree. Because the department operates in every district, posts appear in small towns as well as cities, and there is no domicile restriction beyond the circle you apply to. Basic typing and computer familiarity is part of the test.
summary_ur: پاکستان پوسٹ ملک بھر کے اپنے سرکلز میں پوسٹل اسسٹنٹ اور دیگر کلیریکل عملہ بھرتی کرتا ہے، جس کے لیے ڈگری نہیں بلکہ انٹرمیڈیٹ درکار ہے۔ چونکہ محکمہ ہر ضلعے میں کام کرتا ہے، اس لیے آسامیاں بڑے شہروں کے علاوہ چھوٹے قصبوں میں بھی نکلتی ہیں، اور جس سرکل میں درخواست دیں اس کے علاوہ ڈومیسائل کی کوئی پابندی نہیں۔ ٹیسٹ میں بنیادی ٹائپنگ اور کمپیوٹر کی واقفیت شامل ہوتی ہے۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: Recruitment is organised by postal circle, and you apply to the circle covering your area. Federal quotas reserve shares for women, minorities and persons with disabilities. General age relaxation of five years applies to several categories under federal rules. A typing speed requirement applies to some clerical posts within the same advertisement.

required_documents: Matric and Intermediate certificates with marksheets
Disability or other category certificate, if claiming a reserved seat
application_steps: Look for the current Pakistan Post recruitment advertisement on ep.gov.pk or the department's own site
Identify the postal circle covering your district and the posts open there
Fill the application form as the advertisement directs, online or by post
Deposit the fee if one is required and attach the paid challan
Submit before the closing date and keep a copy
Appear for the written and typing test when called
disclaimer: Pakistan Post advertises circle by circle rather than in one national drive, so which posts are open depends on where you live. Eligibility details were confirmed against the official source on 2026-09-12. The application deadline shown is a provisional placeholder for the expected cycle, not a date the authority has announced - confirm it on the official page before applying.

name: NADRA - Junior Executive and data entry roles
name_ur: نادرا - جونیئر ایگزیکٹو اور ڈیٹا انٹری آسامیاں
target_group: Intermediate or graduate candidates comfortable with computers, looking for registration-centre work
summary_en: NADRA hires Junior Executives and data entry staff for its registration centres across the country. The work is computer-based from the first day, so keyboard confidence matters more than a high degree, and Intermediate is usually enough to apply. Vacancies are advertised centre by centre, which means openings appear in district towns and not only in the big cities.
summary_ur: نادرا ملک بھر کے اپنے رجسٹریشن سینٹرز کے لیے جونیئر ایگزیکٹو اور ڈیٹا انٹری عملہ بھرتی کرتا ہے۔ کام پہلے دن سے کمپیوٹر پر ہوتا ہے، اس لیے اونچی ڈگری سے زیادہ کی بورڈ پر مہارت اہم ہے، اور عموماً انٹرمیڈیٹ کافی ہے۔ آسامیاں سینٹر وار مشتہر ہوتی ہیں، یعنی مواقع صرف بڑے شہروں میں نہیں بلکہ ضلعی قصبوں میں بھی نکلتے ہیں۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: Postings are tied to a specific registration centre, so you apply for a location rather than a general pool. Many of these roles are offered on contract rather than as permanent government posts - check which one the advertisement is offering, because it changes your pension and job security. Women are actively recruited for the female counters at registration centres.

required_documents: Matric and Intermediate certificates with marksheets
Bachelor's degree and transcript, if you have one
Any computer or typing course certificate you hold
application_steps: Open the careers section on nadra.gov.pk and find the centre nearest you
Check whether the post is permanent or contract before applying
Apply online through the NADRA careers portal
Upload your educational documents and CNIC
Submit before the closing date
Appear for the computer-based test and interview when called
disclaimer: Vacancies are tied to individual registration centres, and many roles are offered on contract rather than as permanent government posts - check which the advertisement is offering. Eligibility details were confirmed against the official source on 2026-09-12. The application deadline shown is a provisional placeholder for the expected cycle, not a date the authority has announced - confirm it on the official page before applying.

name: Pakistan Army - Lady Cadet Course (commissioned officer entry for women)
name_ur: پاک فوج - لیڈی کیڈٹ کورس (خواتین کے لیے کمیشنڈ آفیسر بھرتی)
target_group: Women graduates from anywhere in Pakistan seeking a commission as an army officer
summary_en: The Lady Cadet Course is the Pakistan Army's commissioned-officer entry for women graduates, covering branches such as medical, education, legal, engineering and general administration. Candidates apply with a bachelor's degree, pass initial and ISSB selection, and then train before being commissioned. There is no domicile restriction - selection is nationwide.
summary_ur: لیڈی کیڈٹ کورس پاک فوج میں خواتین گریجویٹس کے لیے کمیشنڈ آفیسر بننے کا راستہ ہے، جس میں میڈیکل، تعلیم، قانون، انجینئرنگ اور جنرل ایڈمنسٹریشن جیسے شعبے شامل ہیں۔ امیدوار بیچلر ڈگری کے ساتھ درخواست دیتی ہیں، ابتدائی اور آئی ایس ایس بی انتخاب سے گزرتی ہیں، اور پھر تربیت کے بعد کمیشن حاصل کرتی ہیں۔ ڈومیسائل کی کوئی پابندی نہیں، انتخاب ملک گیر ہوتا ہے۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: This entry is for women only. Age limits differ by branch - the medical and some professional branches allow an older upper limit than the general branch, so check the limit for the branch you are applying to rather than the headline figure. Physical and medical fitness standards apply and are decisive; this screening cannot check them for you.

required_documents: Matric, Intermediate and Bachelor's certificates with transcripts
Medical fitness documentation at the relevant stage
Professional registration certificate, for the medical and legal branches
application_steps: Register online at joinpakarmy.gov.pk when the Lady Cadet Course is open
Confirm the age limit and degree requirement for the branch you want
Complete the online registration and select your Army Selection and Recruitment Centre
Appear for the initial tests - written, physical and medical - at the selection centre
Attend ISSB if you clear the initial stage
Complete final medical and await the merit list
source_title: Join Pakistan Army - Lady Cadet Course registration page
disclaimer: Age limits and accepted degrees differ by branch within the same course, so the age range shown is the general case. Physical and medical standards are decisive and are not screened here. Eligibility details were confirmed against the official source on 2026-09-12. The application deadline shown is a provisional placeholder for the expected cycle, not a date the authority has announced - confirm it on the official page before applying.
